parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the CLB instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-load-balancer-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa08ex0000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
